zip_caveats: ZIPs don't follow ward lines, so use this as a starting point only. 20009 is split with Ward 1: the Dupont Circle and Logan Circle side is Ward 2, while Adams Morgan and the U Street area are Ward 1 (which does have a Council race). 20007 is shared with Ward 3: Georgetown is Ward 2, while Glover Park and points west are Ward 3. 20008 is mostly Ward 3, with small parts in Wards 1 and 2. 20001 is split among Wards 1, 2, 5 and 6. Downtown ZIPs 20004, 20005, 20006, 20036 and 20037 are mostly Ward 2. To be sure, look up your address in the city's ANC locator (https://dcgis.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/lookup/index.html?appid=12bb36e8b77a4a8780125e77e990b146): your district code starts with your ward number. Your mailed ballot is printed for your ward. These ZIP lists come from the home ZIPs of this year's candidates (who must live in the district they run for) plus general geography, not from an official ZIP-to-ward table.

find_my_ward.anc_locator_note: The city's ANC locator (official DC GIS map). Enter your address to get your single-member district code. The code starts with your ward number: 1B05 is Ward 1. Codes starting 3/4G or 6/8F sit on a ward line, so check your ballot.

notes: No ward Council or State Board of Education race this year: those seats were on the 2024 ballot. You still vote in every districtwide race, your ANC race and Initiative 86. Wards 2, 4, 7 and 8 share one ballot style. You can vote at any Vote Center in DC, early (Oct 26 to Nov 1, 8:30 AM to 7 PM) or on Election Day (7 AM to 8 PM); you don't have to stay in your ward.
